thread:
deploy-bot: rollout completed for web-infer-v2 -> stage=canary (20%) @ 03:14 UTC. Afterburner probes started across regions. Reporting probe summary in 60s.
lee: saw a small p95 bump in eu-west after rollout, holding at ~230ms vs baseline 180ms. not sure if transient.
maria: can you paste the afterburner probe logs? curious if tokenization step spiked.
oncall_sre: quick check: 429 rate on canary nodes in eu-west is 1.2% over the last 3m, baseline nodes still <0.1%.
jen: hmm. 1.2% is noisy but not huge. are errors service-level or infra-level? any OOMs in node logs?
lee: tailing logs now, no OOM. lots of small KV cache misses shortly after new variant came up. looks like warmup incomplete.
maria: that explains increased latency and some 429s (backpressure). we didn't run the aggressive prefill for this variant in eu. opsplaybook suggests prefill-warmup for quantized variants.
jen: suggestion: pause the rollout to eu, pin eu to previous version (v1.8) and continue roll in other regions. we can run prefills and then retry.
oncall_sre: agree. applying hold and pin for eu-west now. deploying quickpin -> pinned=web-infer-v1.8 in eu-west.
opsbot: action executed: holdcall applied, region eu-west pinned to web-infer-v1.8. Canary traffic re-routed. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: afterburner probe update: eu-west p95 dropped back to 190ms post-pin, 429s down to 0.08%. other regions unchanged and stable.
lee: i'll kick off prefill-warmup and a targeted KV-warm cache push for the v2 variant in eu staging. command i'm using:

    ./infra/scripts/prefill_cache.sh --region eu-west --model web-infer-v2 --batch 5000

will run for ~6m.
maria: nice. once prefill completes, can we re-run afterburner probes in a small canary slice (5%)? if metrics look good we resume.
jen: yes. set a strict gate: p95 <= 200ms and 429s < 0.2% for 5m window. if met, lift pin and continue rollout.
oncall_sre: noted. i'll monitor and be ready to flip the pin back if anything regresses. :clipboard:
lee: prefill started. ETA 6m.
jen: thanks all. good call to pin eu early. saves customer impact. we'll post a short note in release notes channel after final verification.
maria: ack. will draft the rollout note with timing and mitigation steps.
opsbot: reminder: change window for this rollout is 02:00-06:00 UTC. analytic retention for afterburner probes is 72h.
